recentItems.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska Senate race, defeating Republican Dan Sullivan, AP projects
recentItems.description:
Democrat Mary Peltola will win the race for the U.S. Senate in Alaska, The Associated Press projected, the ninth Senate pickup for Democrats in the next Congress.
 
ABC News’ Jay O’Brien reports.

recentItems.title: Highly classified NSA network goes down amid spate of outages
recentItems.description: Tech outages have hit a top U.S. intelligence agency, along with Apple Pay, email, banking and travel, as the Trump administration says there is no cyberthreat. ABC News' Elizabeth Schulze has the story.

recentItems.title: Hilary Swank defends pregnancy at 52
recentItems.description: Actor Hilary Swank is opening up about being pregnant at 52 and why she thinks stigma around later pregnancies is outdated.

recentItems.title: President Trump arrives in China for high-stakes summit
recentItems.description:
President Trump arrived overnight in China for a high-stakes summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping, joined for the first time by Russian President Vladimir Putin.
 
ABC News' Mary Bruce has the latest.

recentItems.title: Inside Anthropic's potentially record-breaking IPO
recentItems.description:
Google tech policy fellow Mike Muse discusses the tech company's potential record initial public offering valuation.
